title: Durable private execution history
summary: Persist private local observations, delivery cursors and fenced write intents with bounded replay and restore.
acceptance_criteria: Private storage rejects conflicting run identities and preserves monotonic cursors.
Restore and replay pass cross-platform tests; actual host storage and delivery require separate qualification.

evidence.claim: Offline reference implementation and synthetic workload qualification only
Four audit regression methods passed on both Ubuntu and Windows; historical acknowledgment reuse is blocked and exact replay is idempotent.
